tool_calls.code:
import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('focus_billing.csv')
print(df['ChargePeriodStart'].min(), df['ChargePeriodStart'].max())
print(df['ChargeCategory'].unique())

df['ym'] = pd.to_datetime(df['ChargePeriodStart']).dt.strftime('%Y-%m')
piv = df.groupby(['ResourceId','ym'])['BilledCost'].sum().unstack(fill_value=0)
piv['delta'] = piv.get('2026-09',0) - piv.get('2026-08',0)
piv['abs_delta'] = piv['delta'].abs()
top = piv.sort_values('abs_delta', ascending=False).head(10)
print(top[['2026-08','2026-09','delta','abs_delta']])
